title: WordprocessingML Piece-Tree Rope DOM & Sub-Document Parser

vectors.name: PieceTree Initialization and Length
vectors.description: Initializes balanced AVL PieceTree buffer with multi-line text and validates length and line counting.
vectors.input: Hello world!\nThis is line 2.\nAnd line 3.

vectors.name: PieceTree Edge Insertions
vectors.description: Performs text insertions at beginning (offset 0), middle, and end without full buffer reallocation.
vectors.input: Base text 'world' with sequential insertions.

vectors.name: PieceTree Slice Deletion
vectors.description: Performs single and multi-piece deletions at start, middle, and end in O(log N) operations.
vectors.input: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

expected.final_text: quick fox jumps over the lazy

vectors.name: PieceTree Cross-Buffer Slicing
vectors.description: Extracts arbitrary byte slices spanning across original and add piece boundaries.
vectors.input: Sub-range slice extraction across multiple buffers.

vectors.name: PieceTree Line Offset and Coordinate Conversion
vectors.description: Maps between 0-based byte offsets and (line, column) coordinate tuples with multi-line insertions.
vectors.input: Multi-line document with line count verification.

vectors.name: PieceTree 1,000-Page Keystroke Latency SLA Benchmark
vectors.description: Executes 100 random keystroke insertions and deletions on 1,000 pages (~3,000,000 chars) ensuring < 0.5 ms per edit.
vectors.input: 3,000,000 characters text buffer under high edit density.

vectors.name: Paragraph and Run Properties XML Round-Trip
vectors.description: Serializes and parses run properties (bold, italic, underline, strike, color, sz, rFonts) faithfully.
vectors.input: Formatted text run with multiple typographical properties.

vectors.name: Paragraph Alignment and Spacing
vectors.description: Parses and verifies paragraph justification, spacing before/after, line rule, and left/right indents.
vectors.input: Heading paragraph with centered alignment and custom spacing.

vectors.name: Bookmarks Start and End Tags
vectors.description: Round-trips w:bookmarkStart and w:bookmarkEnd elements retaining IDs and bookmark names.
vectors.input: Bookmark with ID 0 named 'Chapter1'.

vectors.name: Hyperlink Elements and Attributes
vectors.description: Serializes and parses w:hyperlink elements containing child runs, target anchors, and tooltips.
vectors.input: Hyperlink pointing to rId4 with anchor 'section2'.

vectors.name: Tracked Revisions (w:ins and w:del)
vectors.description: Preserves tracked author changes, timestamps, and deleted text elements in revisions.
vectors.input: Tracked change insertion by Alice and deletion by Bob.

vectors.name: Table Grid, Rows, and Cell Properties
vectors.description: Models w:tbl, w:tblGrid, w:tr, and w:tc with shading, borders, and column widths.
vectors.input: Table with 2 columns, custom cell background shading, and borders.

vectors.name: Breaks, Tabs, and Special Characters
vectors.description: Serializes and parses w:br (page break), w:tab, w:softHyphen, and w:noBreakHyphen.
vectors.input: Run with page break, tab stop, soft hyphen, and non-breaking hyphen.

vectors.name: Section Properties (w:sectPr)
vectors.description: Round-trips section properties including page size (width/height), margins, and header/footer refs.
vectors.input: Letter portrait page dimensions with 1-inch margins and header/footer bindings.

vectors.name: Raw XML Extension Preservation
vectors.description: Captures and serializes unmodeled XML elements and attributes losslessly via RawXmlNode.
vectors.input: w:customBlock node with nested child element and attributes.

vectors.name: Header Sub-Document Round-Trip
vectors.description: Parses and serializes word/header1.xml parts extracting header text and properties.
vectors.input: w:hdr sub-document with paragraph 'Confidential Document Header'.

vectors.name: Footer Sub-Document Round-Trip
vectors.description: Parses and serializes word/footer1.xml parts with page number runs.
vectors.input: w:ftr sub-document with 'Page 1 of 10'.

vectors.name: Footnotes Sub-Document Round-Trip
vectors.description: Parses separator footnotes and normal footnote bodies within word/footnotes.xml.
vectors.input: Separator footnote (-1) and user footnote (1).

vectors.name: Endnotes Sub-Document Round-Trip
vectors.description: Parses and serializes word/endnotes.xml preserving endnote IDs and formatted bodies.
vectors.input: Endnote with bibliography reference text.

vectors.name: Comments Sub-Document Round-Trip
vectors.description: Parses word/comments.xml preserving author name, initials, ISO timestamps, and comment bodies.
vectors.input: Comment by 'Chief Architect' with initials 'CA'.

vectors.name: Baseline DOCX Package Ingestion
vectors.description: Loads specs/evidence/word/baseline.docx and extracts full text from paragraphs and table cells.
vectors.input: baseline.docx ECMA-376 file.

vectors.name: Baseline DOCX PieceTree Editing
vectors.description: Creates PieceTree rope from baseline.docx and performs real-time text insertions and replacements.
vectors.input: PieceTree initialized from baseline document text.

vectors.name: Baseline DOCX Lossless Round-Trip Fidelity
vectors.description: Serializes opened baseline.docx to bytes and re-opens, verifying bit-for-bit unmodeled part retention.
vectors.input: Full OPC round trip of baseline.docx.

vectors.name: New WordPackage Creation from Scratch
vectors.description: Creates empty WordPackage, appends paragraphs and runs, saves to valid .docx OPC, and reloads.
vectors.input: WordPackage::new() with custom paragraph.

vectors.name: Unmodeled Parts Pass-Through Retention
vectors.description: Validates that custom unmodeled parts (e.g. customXml/item1.xml) survive save and reload.
vectors.input: Custom XML part registered in UnparsedPartStore.

vectors.name: Test Vectors Manifest Self-Validation
vectors.description: Asserts that the test suite and evidence vector manifest are synchronized with at least 25 vectors.
vectors.input: specs/evidence/word/3.1.1_vectors.json.
